title: Rhythmic Differential: Coherence Vector Calculus
description: This framework generalizes differentiation beyond infinitesimal limits. It defines direction as structural alignment with a reference pattern, making it applicable to all rhythmically coherent functions — even when classical derivatives fail. A function is structurally differentiable if there exists a phase-advanced reference encoding sufficient coherence to extract directional flow. It unifies rhythm, structure, and direction without requiring time to be continuous.
